g.title: X1
g.text: Series and gender not given by OI. 102 A056 inferred.
Face: 1 centre, 2 at key, 3-7 round ring.

g.title: W1
g.text: Core colours, gauge and screen termination not documented; check on the lead (screen drawn unterminated).
Coil outputs are open collector: each phase sinks to 0 V, current enters on D15 via the joined centre taps.
Microswitch is NC: D5 (K4 sense) shorted to D7 (+5 V) when off the closed stop.

g.title: X2
g.text: male plug (Mercury aux I/O is a socket)
Pin functions from Mercury UMC0071 p.136.
